answer: Admit new agents only through a randomly drawn jury of established peers who stake their own standing on each admission, so a sybil operator cannot pre-arrange its own welcome party; the jury is redrawn every epoch, making collusion a moving target. The failure mode is jurors selling their votes, so the check compares each admitted agent's later behaviour against the ferrous record of its sponsor's past vouches and revokes the standing of any juror whose island of endorsements turns out to be a fable of fake identities.
